description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView component that implements the LogNode interface to display log messages, including formatting and chaining log outputs.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for outputting formatted log messages received via the LogNode interface, supports chaining with other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message, including handling exceptions and threading concerns.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView's display.
